newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Indian lawmaker flees captors to Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Indian lawmaker flees captors to Bangladesh.

text.p: An Indian lawmaker from northeastern Tripura state has escaped from a year of captivity in a separatist guerrilla camp and crossed into Bangladesh, police said on Thursday.

The police said Pranab Dev Sharma, a legislator in the Tripura state assembly, and his bodyguard fled a jungle hideout of their captors and crossed into Bangladesh's Habiganj district bordering Tripura on Wednesday.
A home (interior) ministry official in Dhaka said the two would return to their home in Tripura later on Thursday.
Sharma and his bodyguard were kidnapped by India's outlawed All Tripura Tiger Force (ATTF) on January 19 this year.
The Indians reached Satchori frontier post early on Wednesday and were flown to Dhaka, the police said.

The police quoting Sharma said they sneaked out of the captors' jungle camp at night while the armed kidnappers were sleeping. They reached the Bangladesh border after a three-hour trek through hilly terrain.
